title: Child food insecurity history — nine Northeast Ohio counties
description: Complete received redistribution: nine counties across 2013–2024. The 2023 rows reflect current revised estimates.
publicationPeriod: Map the Meal Gap 2026 source working edition
dataPeriod: 2013–2024; each row carries its own year
geography: Ashland, Ashtabula, Cuyahoga, Geauga, Lake, Lorain, Medina, Portage and Summit counties
methodology: Current Conduent Healthy Communities Institute CSV redistribution attributes each row to Feeding America. It is retained separately from the 88-county 2024 primary-source cohort. Counts are unavailable for some earlier years. No statistical significance or unadjusted causal trend is inferred.

source.title: Healthy Northeast Ohio child food-insecurity CSV
source.locator: All 108 records; original CSV headers, years, count blanks and rates retained.
source.publisher: Feeding America / Conduent Healthy Communities Institute
source.note: Redistribution maintained by Conduent Healthy Communities Institute, using Feeding America estimates.
source.rights: Published statistical facts with attribution. Source representation and original URLs are retained; publisher branding and narrative are not licensed for reuse.

columns.label: Data year
columns.definition: Original measurement year, not release date.

columns.label: Child food-insecurity rate
columns.definition: Percent of all children under 18 living in food-insecure households.

columns.label: Food-insecure children
columns.definition: Published modeled count, blank where unavailable.
